headline: Laboratorium Coffee Shop / EktraArhitectura
context: Located in the heart of Cluj-Napoca , Laboratorium occupies the ground floor of Palatul Széki — one of four corner buildings constructed at the end of the 19th century to mark the threshold of the city center, and home to the former Matia Corvin Pharmacy.
